text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Both Lucky Lilac and Almond Eye were 
so close...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“The 『Shuka Sho』 is gonna be even more 
heated because of that. It feels like it's 
going to be an incredible race...!”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Pathetic...! This was a race I had to 
win...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Besides, that was unexpected...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I never dreamed that Ai-san would cover 
her stamina weakness to this extent...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It won't go like this at the Shuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Lala. Let's both become much, much 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And this time, I'm definitely going to 
beat everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ai-san—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...This is it.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...At the end of the day, it's not about 
being super fast or anything like that.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(The scariest thing about this girl is 
that unyielding, unbreakable fighting 
spirit of hers.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ai-san bridged the gap in raw talent 
today through sheer unyielding fighting 
spirit alone.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(And next time, I'm sure she'll overcome 
all sorts of things with her sheer 
grit...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(To keep challenging like that over and 
over until she wins. That's Ai-san. But 
you know――)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That's my line.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I've got my pride too, y'know. The pride 
of a Junior-class Queen.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"At the Shuka Sho, things won't go like 
they did today."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's gonna win. ...So let's 
face off again.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit, Lara!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I let the title of Queen of the Oaks slip 
right through my fingers... It's so 
frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...In the upcoming Shuka Sho. I will claim 
victory there, without fail. So please—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to your continued guidance 
and support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The light in Lucky Lilac's eyes is strong. 
Already harboring a quiet fighting spirit 
for her next race, they sparkle with 
dignified resolve.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Wait... What's this all of a sudden?
choice_data_list:
I thought it was behavior befitting a 
queen.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...If that's the case, Trainer, please 
keep standing proudly beside me from now 
on.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
After all, we're the duo that won the URA 
Best Dresser Award.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I puff out my chest. As the trainer of a 
queen, I must stand tall and proud, 
without a trace of shame.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, we reset our mindset. 
Aiming for the final crown, the Shuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Finally, next is the final Tiara, the 
2000m turf 'Shuka Sho' at Kyoto...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I'll show 'em I can win...! If it's me 
and Trainer, we can do it...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Once more, please don't hold back 
as we head toward the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"With that fighting spirit, Ai-san will 
definitely be my greatest rival next time, 
too. ...I've gotta give it everything I've 
got, too."
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's stay focused and go hard!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's do our best.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. ...I just thought my shoelaces 
were a bit loose. Must've been imagining 
things.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...There's no pain. And it doesn't feel 
like fatigue either.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, just now... my body felt kind of 
weird... like it was tensing up.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...If this keeps happening, I should talk 
to Trainer. For now, I'll just keep an eye 
on it—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the days leading up to the Shuka Sho 
began, a faint presence was quietly 
emerging—
